name: silvershop-suite/click-and-collect
description: Local pickup / click & collect (BOPIS) for SilverShop: a dedicated zero-cost PickupShippingMethod that suppresses the shipping address, a first-class collect fulfilment layer on the order (ready-for-pickup / collected), and a styled ready-for-pickup notification email.

suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: Supplies the single implicit pickup location in v1 — the shop address + name shown in the ready-for-pickup email and the admin pickup panel.
suggest.silvershop-suite/order-admin: Surfaces the pickup fulfilment pills in the modern order screen (this module ships a standalone Pickup tab as a fallback).
suggest.silvershop-suite/notification-log: Logs the ready-for-pickup email (fulfilment audit) from the stamped X-SilverShop-Notification-Key header.
suggest.silvershop-suite/storefront: Ships the styled checkout delivery-vs-pickup choice and the account / confirmation 'ready for pickup' wording (this module relies on the existing shipping-method optionset).
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-locations: One pickup method per physical store: the order, the CMS and the pickup email show that store's address and opening hours.
